extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings with next hearing listed at Bristol Family Court
extracted.summary: A solicitor is enquiring about a £14,500 litigation loan for his client, the mother in a divorce, where around £787,000 of property and pensions is in dispute and a hearing is listed on 1 October at Bristol Family Court.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client regarding funding for her divorce proceedings. We have noted the £14,500 requested, the approximately £787,000 in disputed assets, and the hearing listed on 1 October at Bristol Family Court. To take this further we would need your client's full name and contact details, confirmation of your firm's engagement, a breakdown of the costs to be funded (counsel, forensic accountant and your own fees), details and current values of the assets in dispute including any existing charges, and the procedural history and current stage of the case. Our criteria and application form will follow separately, and a member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
